title: Symbiotic Soul Embrace
description: A surreal vertical composition features a central abstract face formed by multiple layered lips and mouths in soft peach and cream tones. Ethereal translucent human silhouettes stand on both sides, surrounded by flowing ribbon-like energy forms, sparkling particles, and delicate light trails against a pale luminous background.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting with a central vertical abstract face constructed from multiple overlapping soft lips and mouths in peach, cream, and pale yellow tones. Translucent human silhouettes stand on left and right sides. Flowing ribbon-like energy streams and sparkling particles rise upward from the central form against a luminous pale blue and white background, delicate glowing trails and subtle red specks, dreamlike and spiritual atmosphere.
